column3: “Jesus” supplies the subject; came renders comes, and the conjunction before beyond is omitted.
The question is presented as direct speech.
BSB’s “God” as subject matches the Textus Receptus (θεός); the critical text has no subject.
“Back” and “Jesus” are supplied; asked renders were asking.
BSB’s “those who brought them” matches the Textus Receptus (προσφέρουσιν); the critical text has “rebuked them.” “Place His hands on” replaces “touch.”
Placing the hands precedes blessing in the wording, instead of accompanying it.
“Jesus” supplies the subject; asked renders was asking.
“Said” renders says; “the rich” renders those having money.
Answering is not separately expressed; said renders says.
